best_idea: Redraw a readout only when a fixed-step counter moves, and rebuild its DOM rows only when the set of rows changes, instead of touching the DOM every frame.
decision_why: Keeps the repaint gate and the frozen-on-pause clock; counts fight ticks instead of wall-clock seconds and keeps the HUD read-only, which fits the one-engine and client-only HUD rulings; rejects the 2 Hz cadence for combat readouts because a duel needs each tick.
acceptance: A client test runs 120 frames (2 s at 60 fps) on a paused fight and asserts the HUD repaint runs 0 times after the first paint; at 1x it repaints once per tick that changed a readout, not once per frame.
